crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my…
Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim…

translations.web: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”
translations.bsb: but he will die in the place to which he was exiled; he will never see this land again.”
translations.kjv: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land
translations.asv: But in the place whither they have led him captive, there shall he die, and he shall see this land no more.
